title: MCA Extends Companies Compliance Facilitation Scheme, 2026 (CCFS-2026) till September 15, 2026
content:
# MCA Extends Companies Compliance Facilitation Scheme, 2026 (CCFS-2026) till September 15, 2026

Ek important update hai! The Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) ne Companies Compliance Facilitation Scheme, 2026 (CCFS-2026) ki validity ko extend karne ka announce kiya hai. This gives companies some extra time for their statutory filings.

*   **Scheme Name:** Companies Compliance Facilitation Scheme, 2026 (CCFS-2026).
*   **Earlier Due Date:** The scheme was previously extended till August 31, 2026, via General Circular No. 03/2026 dated July 8, 2026.
*   **New Due Date:** The scheme is now extended up to **September 15, 2026**.
*   **Notification Details:** This extension has been announced through **General Circular No. 04/2026 dated August 31, 2026**.
*   **Reason for Extension:** The decision to extend the scheme was made after receiving representations from various stakeholders.
*   **Key Point:** All other terms and conditions of the CCFS-2026 will remain unchanged.
